name: Danganronpa: Restrained Nature
source:
"This Social Experiment will help you further develop your talent". This is what Yuna Kaigosha, Ultimate Child Caregiver, thought was going to happen, but instead, she and another couple of Ultimates are thrown in a cruel killing game run by a genocidal black and white bear. Will Yuna be able to face the killing game by trusting her new comrades, or will these so-called friends betray her and stab her in the back?

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/Danganronpa_RN/748862]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
“这个社会实验将帮助你进一步发展你的才能”。这正是终极儿童看护者尤娜·凯戈莎 (Yuna Kaigosha) 所认为会发生的事情，但相反，她和另外几个终极者被扔进了一场由种族灭绝的黑白熊主持的残酷杀戮游戏中。尤娜能否通过信任她的新伙伴来面对这场杀戮游戏，还是这些所谓的朋友会背叛她并在背后捅她一刀？

[来自[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/Danganronpa_RN/748862]GameJolt[/url]]
